message.content: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","agent_id":"coder","description":"Implement a fast Python Fibonacci cache and verify it with a real run. Create a module named fib_cache.py containing at minimum: (a) naive_recursive(n) (simple recursion), (b) cached_recursive(n) using functools.lru_cache, and (c) iterative(n) as the correct high-performance reference. Add a runnable test/benchmark script (test_fib.py) that: 1) verifies correctness by comparing all implementations for sample inputs [0,1,2,5,10,50,100,500] (use iterative as the oracle); 2) measures wall-clock timings (time.perf_counter or timeit) for representative inputs (e.g., n=100, n=1000, n=5000 or other sensible sizes) for each implementation; 3) performs one concrete real run (not just microbench loops) and captures stdout, timings, and any exceptions. Save the source code and the run outputs into a single artifact file fib_results.json containing: source files as text, test assertions results, timing numbers, the exact commands used to run the tests, and the captured stdout/stderr. Ensure the test script exits nonzero on failure and include brief run instructions in the JSON. Make the code idiomatic and include type hints and small inline comments.","dependencies":[],"produces":"fib_results.json","consumes":[],"rationale":"coder can write, run and time Python code","needs_tools":["terminal","write_file","code_analysis"]},{"id":"s2","agent_id":"creative","description":"Read fib_results.json produced by the implementation step, and produce a user-friendly Markdown report fib_report.md that: 1) summarizes the implemented approaches and why the chosen cache is fast; 2) embeds short, relevant code excerpts (not entire files) for the cached implementation; 3) tabulates the correctness checks and timing results from fib_results.json and highlights the fastest approach; 4) documents exact commands to reproduce the real run and any caveats; and 5) include a one-paragraph recommendation for the user (which implementation to use). Write the report to fib_report.md and ensure it references fib_results.json for full details.","dependencies":["s1"],"produces":"fib_report.md","consumes":["fib_results.json"],"rationale":"creative writes a clear user-facing report","needs_tools":["read_file","write_file"]}]}
